name: claude-observe
description: Marketplace for claude-observe — session observability for Claude Code, recording what the transcript cannot.

plugins.name: claude-observe
plugins.description: Records the events a transcript can never contain — liveness and pid, why a session ended, typed tool failures, denied permissions, API-killed turns, subagent lifecycle, compaction boundaries — to an append-only log, and reports on them. Hooks only rare and failure paths, so it adds no latency to the tool loop.
